title: Combination Sum-II
problemStatement: Solve “Combination Sum-II” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Subsequences Pattern).
intuition: "Combination Sum-II" explores a decision tree: choose → recurse → undo. Prune early with constraints. Watch exponential blow-up (TLE) and recursion depth (RE).

approaches.title: Backtracking template
approaches.idea: Maintain path; at leaf record answer; undo after recurse.
approaches.code:
def solve(n):
    ans = []
    path = []

    def dfs(start):
        # adapt base condition for: Combination Sum-II
        ans.append(path.copy())
        for i in range(start, n):
            path.append(i)
            dfs(i + 1)
            path.pop()  # undo

    dfs(0)
    return ans
approaches.time: O(2^n · poly) typical for subsets; worse for permutations
approaches.dryRun: Show one choose/undo branch on a tiny n.
